Убивай мобов в зоне босса: Kill mobs in the boss's zone
Над хотбаром появится шкала: она заполня: A bar appears above the hotbar: it fills with kills of that mob type. The zone is listed in the "Where and how" section.
Когда шкала заполнится, босс появится ря: When the bar is full, the boss spawns next to you. Tier mechanics are in the "Boss tiers" table. If you run out of time or die, the quest fails.

Опыт слеера начисляется сразу. Новый кве: Slayer XP is added right away. A new quest is again at Maddox or via the Batphone.
В меню Maddox выбери редкий дроп в RNG M: In Maddox's menu pick a rare drop in the RNG Meter: every boss adds points, and with a full bar the item is guaranteed to drop.

Возьми снаряжение из чек-листа ниже (мас: Take the gear from the checklist below ("second life" masks, Aspect of the Void, a Spirit pet) and potions. The class is picked in the dungeon menu before the start.
Убивай мобов, ищи секреты, решай головол: Kill mobs, find secrets, solve puzzles. Wither Keys and Blood Keys drop from mobs: they open doors and the Blood Room.
В Blood Room The Watcher выпускает мобов: In the Blood Room, The Watcher releases mobs: kill them all and the way to the floor boss opens.

S+ даёт больше опыта Catacombs и лучший: S+ gives more Catacombs XP and better loot: no deaths, with secrets and fast.

Kuudra Gatekeeper или Party Finder на Cr: Kuudra Gatekeeper or the Party Finder on Crimson Isle: 4 players, pick a tier you have unlocked.
Принеси припасы и построй баллисту: Bring supplies and build the ballista
Сначала команда собирает Supplies по аре: First the team gathers Supplies around the arena and carries them to the ballista, then everyone stands in the build zone until the ballista is finished.
Стреляй из баллисты и бей Kuudra, когда: Fire the ballista and hit Kuudra when it surfaces. Infernal has an extra final phase.
Бесплатный сундук даётся всегда, платный: The free chest is always given, the paid one needs a Kuudra Key of its tier. Compare the key price with the loot value in the table below.

Доска в Community Center своего города:: The board in your town's Community Center: up to 5 quests per day. The reward is reputation, which unlocks Kuudra tiers.
Dojo — семь испытаний. Зайди с пустым ин: The Dojo has seven tests. Enter with an empty inventory and no pet, do each at least once, then raise the weak ones to S rank for the belt.
Обойди мини-боссов и Matriarch: Visit the minibosses and the Matriarch
Мини-боссы дают квестовые убийства и шан: Minibosses give quest kills and a chance at a Kuudra Key. The Matriarch in the volcano gives 3 Heavy Pearls a day, needed for Kuudra armor stars.
Лучшая открытая тебе удочка — в таблице: The best rod unlocked for you is in the "Rods" table. Parts (line, hook, sinker) are fitted by Roddy in Backwater Bayou (/warp bayou): right-click him, put in the rod and the part.
Сейчас лучший опыт — лава Crimson Isle (: The best XP now is Crimson Isle lava (/warp nether). Lava Hotspots (patches with particles) give their own bonuses and creatures.
Положи наживку в Fishing Bag, надень пит: Put bait in the Fishing Bag, equip a fishing pet (Flying Fish, Ammonite) and armor with Sea Creature Chance.
Sea Creature надо убить — опыт и дроп да: A Sea Creature has to be killed: XP and drops come from the kill. Thunder and Lord Jawbus are strong: bring friends or a good weapon.
Trophy Fish неси Odger на вершине Blazin: Bring Trophy Fish to Odger at the top of the Blazing Volcano: he counts species, gives Trophy Fisher rewards and fillets spares into Magmafish.
Thunder Fragment, Magma Lord Fragment и: Thunder Fragment, Magma Lord Fragment and Radioactive Vial go on the Bazaar or auction house (prices in the "Money making" table).

Hunter Armor и зуб Odger (бесплатно за р: Hunter Armor and Odger's tooth (free for Odger ranks), Hot Bait in the Fishing Bag, Trophy Line from Roddy, a Kuudra pet. The stat multiplies each species' chance.
Встань в нужную зону или выполни приём (: Stand in the right zone or use the right technique (geyser, 8 blocks high, 20 seconds of waiting, Obfuscated bait). Conditions for all 18 species are in the table below.
Odger на вершине Blazing Volcano засчиты: Odger at the top of the Blazing Volcano counts species and tiers, gives rank rewards and fillets fish into Magmafish.
План ниже: сначала новые виды, потом сер: The plan below: new species first, then silver (Adept), gold (Expert) and diamond (Master), and within each from the fastest.
Телепорт /warp mines. Бери задания (Comm: Teleport /warp mines. Take Commissions from the Emissary or via the Royal Pigeon: they give Heart of the Mountain XP and Mithril Powder.
Открой /hotm: токены тратятся на новые п: Open /hotm: tokens go to new perks, Powder to perk levels. Important perks are listed in the table below.
The Forge (/warp forge) работает в реаль: The Forge (/warp forge) works in real time: put in a profitable recipe and collect it a few hours later.
Купи пропуск у Gwendolyn в Dwarven Mines: Buy a pass from Gwendolyn in the Dwarven Mines, go down to the Crystal Hollows, collect 5 crystals and place them in the Crystal Nucleus.
Из Dwarven Base Camp (/warp basecamp) ид: From the Dwarven Base Camp (/warp basecamp) go to the Glacite Tunnels: Umber, Tungsten, gems. If a Mineshaft opens, loot the Frozen Corpses.
Телепорт /warp garden. Выполняй заказы V: Teleport /warp garden. Fill Visitor orders at the Desk: that's Copper and Garden XP. Decline if an order costs more than the reward.
Какая культура сейчас выгоднее — на стра: Which crop pays best right now is on the "Money making" page. During a Jacob's Contest, farm one of the contest's three crops.
Desk → Crop Upgrades: +5 Farming Fortune: Desk → Crop Upgrades: +5 Farming Fortune to the crop per level. Cheap levels first.
Pests появляются на участках при фарме и: Pests appear on plots while farming and cut growth. Suck them up with a vacuum (SkyMart Vacuum); the drops sell.
Медали Jacob's Contest меняй у Anita на: Trade Jacob's Contest medals at Anita for permanent Farming Fortune.
Телепорт /warp galatea. Начни с заданий: Teleport /warp galatea. Start with Hina's tasks in Moonglade Marsh: they unlock zones and give Heart of the Forest XP.
Fig и Mangrove: за полностью срубленное: Fig and Mangrove: a fully felled tree drops a Tree Gift with loot and Whispers. Helix (Torrhus Canyon) gives Desert Whispers.
Открой меню Heart of the Forest: токены: Open the Heart of the Forest menu: tokens go to new perks, Whispers to levels (Sweep, Foraging Fortune).
Fig Hew и броня Canopy с Foraging 12, да: Fig Hew and Canopy armor at Foraging 12, then Figstone (15) and Helix (20–25). On the axe: the Moonglade reforge and a Wood Singularity.
Sloth у Miria (Torrhus Canyon), Frog и о: Sloth from Miria (Torrhus Canyon), Frog and Crow/Heron shards from Agatha, for Starlyn Contest coupons.
Соревнования по рубке у Agatha: чем боль: Chopping contests at Agatha: the more points, the more coupons. Sloth and the Torrhus Belt boost points.
Таблица «Самые дешёвые следующие крафты»: The "Cheapest next crafts" table below: start from the top.

Super Compactor 3000, Diamond Spreading: Super Compactor 3000, Diamond Spreading or Flycatcher, and permanent fuel (Enchanted Lava Bucket and up).
Музей стоит в Hub (/hub), Madame Eleanor: The museum is in the Hub (/hub); Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth III at the entrance opens the Your Museum menu: section percentages, Special Items, milestones and search.
Открой меню музея и кликни по предмету в: Open the museum menu and click an item in your inventory → Confirm Donation. The item goes to its section's display and gives SkyBlock XP right away.
Сет сдаётся только когда все его части (: A set can only be donated when all its pieces (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, and for some also a belt and cloak) are in your inventory. All pieces are donated at once.
Высший тир засчитывает низшие: A higher tier counts the lower ones
Сдал улучшенную версию — младшие тиры то: Donate the upgraded version and the lower tiers count too (Aspect of the Void covers Aspect of the End). A lower tier donated after a higher one gives no XP.
Забирай обратно, когда нужно: Take it back when you need it
Клик по своему предмету в музее возвраща: Clicking your item in the museum returns it (Borrowing). The XP stays, and you can put the item back on display any time. Donated items become Co-op Soulbound: they can't be sold anymore.
Каждые 100 XP музея — веха (всего 40). О: Every 100 museum XP is a milestone (40 total). Open Museum Milestones and claim rewards: +1% Bits Multiplier, +2% Bank Interest, and at milestone 3 the Museum Appraisal and Deluxe Bank Upgrade.
Special Items (трофеи событий и редкости: Special Items (event trophies and rarities) go on a separate page. They give no XP, only for the collection and the museum appraisal.

Меню Essence Crafting: положи предмет, и: The Essence Crafting menu: put in an item and it shows the price of the next star. Start with what you use every day: weapon and armor.
Открой магазин нужной эссенции и бери пе: Open the shop for the essence you need and take perks in level order. Wither Essence goes to the Forbidden perks first: permanent stats.
С Catacombs 20 недостающую эссенцию можн: From Catacombs 20 you can buy missing essence on the Bazaar (Forest has no requirement). Compare the star price with the price difference between the item with and without stars.
Galatea → Tangleburg: David Hunterboroug: Galatea → Tangleburg: David Hunterborough, then Alan (Huntaxe), Oden, Albert (Black Hole), Jaeger (net) and Auryon (lasso). At the end Kysha shows fusion.
Боевых мобов бей Huntaxe до 10% здоровья: Hit combat mobs with a Huntaxe down to 10% health and place a Black Hole, catch water ones with a net, forest ones with the lasso. Catches go straight to the Hunting Box.
Huntrap ловит осколок за сутки сама. Сол: A Huntrap catches a shard in a day by itself. Salt (Lushlilac) gives a shard chance from any killed mob: eat it before farming.
/huntingbox → кликни по осколку: он прок: /huntingbox → click a shard: it levels its attribute. You need the Hunting level for its rarity (Uncommon 5, Rare 10, Epic 15, Legendary 20).
Fusion Machine в Tangleburg: два вида ос: The Fusion Machine in Tangleburg: two kinds of shards → a new one. This is how Hunter Fortune attributes and Hideonring (accessory slots) are made.
Команда /cf. Накликай 50 Chocolate и най: The /cf command. Click 50 Chocolate and hire Rabbit Bro: after that Chocolate builds up by itself.
Сначала младших: при равном уровне у них: Juniors first: at equal level their +1 Chocolate/s is cheaper. The cap grows with prestige.
С престижа 2. Заряд копится 8 часов, дер: From prestige 2. A charge builds for 8 hours, hold no more than three: turn it on while you play.
Когда накопишь нужный Chocolate с прошло: Once you've saved the required Chocolate since the last prestige, raise the factory level: the multiplier and cap grow. Spend the extra in the Chocolate Shop first.
Весной — яйца Hoppity (лучше в Crystal H: In spring, Hoppity's eggs (best in the Crystal Hollows); all year, island residents and stray rabbits in the factory window.
Hypixel отдаёт только число собранных Fa: Hypixel only reports how many Fairy Souls you have. Open an island below and press "Found" on collected ones (or "Mark whole island"), and only the missing ones stay.
Души внутри острова отсортированы маршру: Souls on an island are sorted along a route from the warp. The hint says which /warp to start from, how many blocks and in which direction, at what height. The 📍 button copies coordinates for a waypoint mod.
Каждые 5 душ — обмен у Tia the Fairy в H: Every 5 souls trade at Tia the Fairy in the Hub (Fairy Pond in the Wilderness) for permanent stats.
С телефоном в инвентаре подойди к NPC и: With the phone in your inventory, walk up to an NPC and talk. No-condition ones first, then meet the conditions from the list.
Melody в Парке (/warp park). Песни откры: Melody in The Park (/warp park). Songs unlock one by one, and the first clear of each gives permanent Intelligence.
В Hub иди в Wizard Tower (/warp wizard),: In the Hub go to the Wizard Tower (/warp wizard), do a Dimensional Infusion at the Wizard and step into the portal.
Enigma стоит у подножия Wizard Tower в Р: Enigma stands at the foot of the Wizard Tower in the Rift, the cloak costs 100 Motes: each soul gives +20 s of Rift Time.
Координаты душ — в таблице ниже (их удоб: Soul coordinates are in the table below (easy to enter into a waypoint mod). Place timecharms in Elise's gallery.
Собирай розовые шарики, продавай Рифт-пр: Collect pink orbs, sell Rift items to the Motes Grubber, kill bosses.
Нужен Globulate Timecharm и доступ в Sti: Needs the Globulate Timecharm and access to Stillgore Château in the Rift.
Maddox в замке Stillgore Château, оплата: Maddox in Stillgore Château, paid in Motes.
Проверь, идёт ли ивент: Check whether the event is on
Мифологический ритуал идёт, только пока: The Mythological Ritual runs only while Diana has this perk (as mayor or minister). Whether it's on now is shown at the top of the guide and on the "Events" page.
Возьми Griffin и лопату: Get a Griffin and a spade
Надень питомца Griffin (чем выше редкост: Equip a Griffin pet (the higher the rarity, the more mob kinds) and get an Ancestral Spade from Diana in the Hub.
В Hub нажми ПКМ лопатой (Echo): частицы: In the Hub right-click with the spade (Echo): particles show the way to the nearest griffin burrow. Dig the burrow with the spade.
После каждой норы Echo ведёт к следующей: After each burrow Echo leads to the next. At the end of the chain is treasure or a mythological mob; kill it before others finish it.
Griffin Feather, Ancient Claw и Mythos F: Griffin Feathers, Ancient Claws and Mythos Fragments go into Griffin stones (upgrades at Kat), spades and armor. Sell rare drops on the auction house or Bazaar.

The Forge (/warp forge) работает в реаль: The Forge (/warp forge) works in real time: put in a recipe and collect it a few hours later. What is profitable and how to build drill parts — in the The Forge guide.

Из Dwarven Base Camp (/warp basecamp) ид: From Dwarven Base Camp (/warp basecamp) go to the Glacite Tunnels: Umber, Tungsten, gemstones. If a Mineshaft opens, loot the Frozen Corpses and claim milestone rewards from Grandpa Wolf (/corpsemilestones).
Зачаровывай вещи на Enchantment Table (/: Enchant items on the Enchantment Table (/et with a Booster Cookie) or apply books on the anvil. Minecraft XP comes from Experience Bottles: the Librarian in the Hub sells them for 30 coins.
Experimentation Table: 8 Oak Log и Exper: Experimentation Table: 8 Oak Log and an Experience Bottle. Place it on your Private Island (/warp home) and right-click it.
Chronomatron и Ultrasequencer: повтори ц: Chronomatron and Ultrasequencer: repeat the colour chain and the number order. They give XP and extra clicks for Superpairs.

У стола 3 заряда, они возвращаются через: The table has 3 charges that come back after 24 hours. 3 more runs a day can be bought with Bits and XP levels.

SkyBlock Menu → Your Skills → Combat → B: SkyBlock Menu → Your Skills → Combat → Bestiary → Milestones: +1 Health per milestone and Combat XP every 5 milestones.
Spooky Festival, Diana и Season of Jerry: Spooky Festival, Diana and Season of Jerry: their mobs' first tiers are almost free, but only while the event runs.
Выбери питомца под занятие: Pick a pet for the activity
